# Interbrand

> > Leading global brand consultancy specializing in brand strategy, design, valuation, and the annual Best Global Brands rankings.

Interbrand provides comprehensive brand consulting services including strategic positioning, brand economics, and design solutions. The firm is best known for its annual Best Global Brands report, a longitudinal study ranking and valuing the world's top 100 brands since 2000, featuring companies like Lego, Bugatti, Mini, Juventus, and British Air.

## Key Topics

- Best Global Brands
- Brand Valuation
- Brand Economics
- Top 100 Brands Rankings
- Brand Strategy
- Brand Design
- Brand Consultancy
- Market Value Analysis
- M&A Brand Strategy
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- Brand Equity
- Iconic Moves
- Longitudinal Brand Study
- Global Brand Rankings

## Best Global Brands Rankings

- [Best Global Brands 2025](https://interbrand.com/best-global-brands/global): Top 100 global brand rankings & valuation with historical data since 2000
- [Best Global Brands 2023 Report](https://interbrand.com/best-global-brands/global/2023-report): 2023 Best Global Brands report with Top 100 brand rankings & market value
- [Best Global Brands 2020 Report](https://interbrand.com/best-global-brands/global/2020-report): 2020 Best Global Brands report with Top 100 brand rankings & analysis
